title: OC Registrar of Voters Media Tour | Election Security & Integrity | '26 Primary Election
description:
On May 27, 2026, Orange County Registrar of Voters Bob Page hosted an on-site tour to give media an inside look at how Orange County processes, verifies, and secures every vote in the 2026 Statewide Direct Primary Election.

Registrar Bob Page led the tour alongside U.S. Election Assistance Commission Vice Chair Christy McCormick, OC First District Supervisor Janet Nguyen, and District Attorney Todd Spitzer.
